protocol: Saved-evidence diagnostics; no retraining, no new test selection.

paired_document_bootstrap.sampling: Ordinary paired document resampling; identical sampled documents across all nine classifiers.
paired_document_bootstrap.estimand: Difference in mean macro F1 across each method's three frozen classifiers.
paired_document_bootstrap.limitation: Intervals condition on trained models and observed document population. They do not estimate optimizer-run uncertainty or repair prior test exposure; no equivalence margin is tested.

symmetric_confirmation.target: Mean response across the same five existing development folds.

interval_interpretation.RSM: Working-model PI for an average of five new independent residuals in known fixed blocks: t * sqrt(MSE*(1/5+leverage)).
interval_interpretation.GP: Saved GP model-based predictive interval for the block-averaged response; includes fitted GP white-noise variance.

symmetric_confirmation.limitation: Intervals have the same response target but different variance models. Overlapping training folds and repeated use of the same coordinates preclude treating these records as independent datasets.

capacity_matching.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive comparison across different fixed input documents and configurations, not a new deployment requirement or a proof that any threshold is structurally unreachable.

reference_sensitivity.grid_rule: Fixed diagnostic loss references 0.15, 0.20, 0.30 and original 1.0; latency references 200, 250, original 358.3 and 500 microseconds. No application requirement is inferred.
reference_sensitivity.target: Selection and hypervolume recomputed on observed development configurations; no test-set evaluation of newly selected points.

search_cost.scope: Search evaluation elapsed time plus recorded design/surrogate/explanation overhead; excludes confirmation, final refits and local word study. First-use GPU initialization and randomized serial method order affect these descriptive costs.

interaction_leverage.limitation: Descriptive correlations of six strengths fitted to shared observations, not independent validation of explanation correctness.

phase_a_diagnostics.interpretation: Post-hoc sensitivity analyses. The restricted learning-rate design aliases the linear and squared learning-rate columns; rank-aware fits do not identify these effects separately. A changed lack-of-fit statistic is not a causal attribution to the excluded boundary.
phase_a_diagnostics.denominator: Structural lack of fit versus pooled additive treatment-plus-block residual, matching the historical decomposition; the denominator is not center pure error.
